# uem_profile (Resource)

Manages a Workspace ONE UEM Profile



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name
- `org_group_id` (String) Organization Group ID
- `platform` (String) Platform: Android, Apple iOS, AppleOsX, Windows 10, Windows_Rugged, or Linux

### Optional

- `assigned_smart_groups` (List of String) List of SmartGroup IDs to assign to this profile.
- `assignment_type` (String) Assignment type: Auto or Optional. Defaults to Auto
- `credentials_list` (Attributes List) Credential payloads for macOS profiles. Each entry either uploads a certificate file (credential_source = "Upload") or references a pre-configured Certificate Authority (credential_source = "DefinedCertificateAuthority"). Reference a credential in a network_list entry via identity_certificate = <credential_name>. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials_list))
- `custom_settings_list` (Attributes List) Custom settings payloads (macOS, iOS, and Android). Each item contains an XML/plist custom settings string. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_settings_list))
- `description` (String) Profile description
- `disk_encryption` (Attributes) Disk encryption (FileVault 2) settings (macOS only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk_encryption))
- `excluded_smart_groups` (List of String) List of SmartGroup IDs to exclude from this profile.
- `gatekeeper` (Attributes) macOS Security & Privacy payload (called GateKeeper in the WS1 API). Controls auto-unlock, Touch ID, Handoff, screen capture, and software update deferral. Applies to macOS only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gatekeeper))
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the profile is active. Defaults to true
- `lock_screen_message` (String) Lock screen message (Android only)
- `network_list` (Attributes List) Network (Wi-Fi / Ethernet) payloads for macOS profiles. Each item configures one network connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_list))
- `passcode` (Attributes) Passcode policy settings (macOS and iOS) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--passcode))
- `profile_context` (String) Profile context: Device or User. Required for AppleOsX profiles (defaults to Device)
- `profile_scope` (String) Profile scope: Production or Test. Defaults to Production
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Restrictions settings (macOS only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile ID
- `uuid` (String) Profile UUID

<a id="nestedatt--credentials_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials_list`

Required:

- `credential_source` (String) Source of the credential. Valid values: "Upload" (base64 certificate file) or "DefinedCertificateAuthority" (pre-configured CA in UEM).

Optional:

- `allow_access_to_all_applications` (Boolean) When true, all apps on the device can access the private key in the Keychain.
- `certificate_authority` (Number) Numeric ID of the Certificate Authority in UEM. Required when credential_source is "DefinedCertificateAuthority".
- `certificate_id` (Number) Numeric certificate ID assigned by UEM after upload. Computed automatically when credential_source is "Upload"; leave unset for DefinedCertificateAuthority.
- `certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) Password protecting the certificate file. Required for encrypted .pfx/.p12 files.
- `certificate_payload` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded certificate file (.pfx, .p12, or .cer). Required when credential_source is "Upload". Use filebase64("path/to/cert.pfx") to load from disk.
- `certificate_template` (Number) Numeric ID of the certificate template within the CA. Required when credential_source is "DefinedCertificateAuthority".
- `credential_name` (String) Human-readable name for this credential, referenced by identity_certificate in network payloads. Required when credential_source is "Upload" so network_list entries can join to it; optional for DefinedCertificateAuthority credentials, which are identified by certificate_authority + certificate_template.
- `key_is_extractable` (Boolean) Allow export of the private key from the Keychain (macOS 10.15+). Corresponds to "Allow export of private key from Keychain" in the UI.

### Nested Schema for `custom_settings_list`

Required:

- `custom_settings` (String) Custom settings XML/plist content

<a id="nestedatt--gatekeeper"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gatekeeper`

Optional:

- `allow_auto_unlock` (Boolean) If false, disallows macOS auto unlock with Apple Watch (defaults to true).
- `allow_fingerprint_for_unlock` (Boolean) If false, prevents Touch ID from unlocking a device.
- `allow_handoff` (Boolean) If false, disables activity continuation features in macOS.
- `allow_screen_capture` (Boolean) If false, users can't save a screenshot of the display and are prevented from capturing a screen recording; it also prevents the Classroom app from observing remote screens.
- `enable_app_software_update_delay` (Boolean) Enable delay for non-OS app software updates.
- `enable_software_update_delay` (Boolean) Enable delay for OS software updates.
- `enforced_software_update_delay` (Number) Number of days a software update on the device is delayed (default 30 once a delay toggle is enabled).
